2025 BEACH PARKING – FAQs
Where do I need a sticker to park?
Parking at Gulf Beach and Walnut Beach requires a Resident Sticker or an hourly parking ticket (on street only).
When do I need a sticker to park or when does the non-resident fee parking fee apply?
From May 1st to and including September 30th of each year during beach hours (sunrise to 10:00p).
Where do I get a Resident Parking Sticker?
Annual Resident Parking Stickers are available from the Milford Tax Collector’s Office (70 West River St). You
must bring your current motor vehicle registration(s) and your taxes must be paid up to date. Call the Tax
Collector for more information: 203-783-3217.
Can non-residents buy a “Season Pass”?
Season Passes are available for $250.00 at the Milford Recreation Department (70 West River Street). Season
Passes are only valid for parking at Gulf Beach and Walnut Beach. Call the Recreation Department for more
information: 203-783-3280.
How much does it cost to park without a current Resident Parking Sticker?
The fee is $40.00 per day per car at the Gulf and Walnut Beach parking lots. The fee is $5.00 per hour or $40.00
per day for street parking at Walnut Beach.
How do I pay?
Parking can be paid online at park.passportparking.com/park or scan the QR code below. Simply enter your
parking zone AND license plate OR parking space number.
I am a resident but I did not get my sticker yet. Do I have to pay? Yes.
Do handicapped individuals without a current Residents Parking Sticker have to pay? Yes.
I'm here for an event or activity, do I need to pay to park?
Yes, anyone without a current Resident Parking Sticker must pay to park.
If the Police give me a ticket, how much does it cost?
All beach parking violations issued by the Milford Police cost $85.00 plus surcharges. All ticket inquiries can be
directed to the Milford Police Department (430 Boston Post Road). Call the Milford Police Department for more
information 203-878-6551.
